Definition: a kind of tree or wood (as used for building), apparently the cypress
BiblicalUsage: gôpher is the word for a kind of tree or wood (as used for building), apparently the cypress. In Genesis 6:14, the text says "Make thee an ark of gopher wood."
TheologicalSignificance: This one, gôpher, I take at face value: a kind of tree or wood, apparently the cypress.
RelatedTopics: Word of God; Faith; Christian Life
